label: Zhubajie (猪八戒)
terms_note: Developer registers on open.zbj.com (注册成为开发者 → 创建应用 → 测试 → 发布); apps go through the 工具市场 for service providers; OAuth2.0 user authorisation + signature; FAQ has a '应用API流量扩大申请' item so quotas are per-app and raised on request; seller side needs 实名认证、资质考核、保证金缴纳.

config_fields.name: openid
config_fields.help: Your 猪八戒 openid (用户唯一标识, returned with the access token by the ZOP OAuth2.0 authorisation); every service-provider method takes it.

fields.name: app_key
fields.help: appKey (应用证书) of your approved ZOP application (open.zbj.com > 控制台).

fields.name: app_secret
fields.help: Application secret (应用密钥); signs every call as uppercase hex SHA1 of secret + params sorted by name + secret (签名算法). Never sent on the wire.

fields.name: access_token
fields.help: accessToken (访问令牌) from the ZOP OAuth2.0 authorisation of your 猪八戒 服务商 account (https://open.zbj.com/wiki/getWikiCategoryAll?wikiId=8): valid 7 days by default (refresh at http://openapi.zbj.com/oauth2/refreshtoken), or for the purchase period for 工具市场 apps.

adapter.terms: 猪八戒开放平台 (ZOP) router API (https://open.zbj.com/wiki/getWikiCategoryAll?wikiId=9): every call is GET https://openapi.zbj.com/router with appKey, accessToken, method, v=1.0, format=json, a 13-digit timestamp and sign = uppercase hex SHA1 of appSecret + name/value pairs sorted by name + appSecret (https://open.zbj.com/wiki/getWikiCategoryAll?wikiId=11). Failures answer {errorToken, code, message, solution, subErrors}. Applications are subject to platform approval (应用运营规则); prices are CNY.

me.note: zbj.user.getServiceUserInfo (openid): nickname, username, mobile, userEmail, brandname (shop name) and openid of the authorised 服务商.

list_products.note: zbj.service.getServiceList: the 服务商's services (state 1 全部 is always requested; the status filter is not applied). state: 2 出售中, 3 已下架, 4 未通过审核; amount is the web price in CNY (amountApp the app price); sales = successful deals; addtime/lasttime are epoch seconds.

list_sales.note: zbj.trade.querySoldServices: service orders sold by the 服务商 (taskId, title, taskMode 11 购买服务 / 12 雇佣, taskState 0 草稿 … 4 结束并打款, amount and hostedAmount in CNY, createtime epoch seconds, employer nickname). since maps to startTime (yyyyMMddHHmmss); orders carry no service id, so product_id is not applied.

list_refunds.note: zbj.trade.getRefundList: refund requests on the 服务商's trades. refundState 1 待确认退款, 2 退款成功, 3 退款关闭, 4 已拒绝, 5 已撤销, 6 退款处理中; refundAmount (requested) and paidAmount in CNY; createTime epoch seconds. The page size is fixed by the platform (limit and since are not applied).

not_offered.get_product: zbj.service.getServiceDetail (serviceId + openid, https://open.zbj.com/api/apiDetailIndex?methodId=38&groupId=8) answers subject, amount, content, categories and cases but does not echo the service id, which the vocabulary's product record requires; use list_products (which carries serviceId, subject, amount, state and serviceurl).
not_offered.create_product: zbj.service.addService (https://open.zbj.com/api/apiDetailIndex?methodId=72&groupId=8) requires a third-level categoryId (from zbj.user.getCategoryByUserId), a cover imgurl uploaded through zbj.services.uploadCoverPic, separate PC and app prices and contents and a unit, none of which the vocabulary carries, and its success response ({successful: true}) returns no service id.
not_offered.update_price: The only way to change a service's price is zbj.service.editService (https://open.zbj.com/api/apiDetailIndex?methodId=74&groupId=8), a full replacement that requires subject, amount, amountApp, unit, imgurl, cont, contApp and categoryId together; there is no price-only call (zbj.trade.sellerEditAmount changes the amount of one hire/purchase trade, not a listing).
not_offered.get_sales_stats: No revenue or totals method is documented: the 交易API group (https://open.zbj.com/api/apiIndex) lists trades, refunds and workflow steps only.
not_offered.refund: The 服务商 cannot issue a refund through the API: refunds are requested by the employer, and the 交易API group (https://open.zbj.com/api/apiIndex) only reads them (zbj.trade.getRefundList).

live_check.notes: requires app_key, app_secret, access_token, openid; started, listed tools and answered a clean auth_error naming the variables
